_comment: Expo config for the med-consult phones. Values here are not arbitrary — the ones that matter are
called out below because getting any of them wrong fails at runtime on a device, which is the
slowest possible place to find out.
jsEngine: 'jsc'      QVAC's Bare bridge and the Holepunch stack are exercised on JSC, not Hermes.
plugin on Android (RN ships Hermes by default there).
newArchEnabled       react-native-bare-kit expects the new architecture.
NSLocalNetworkUsage  iOS 14+ blocks local-network discovery until the user grants it. Without
+ NSAllowsLocal      this the airplane-mode LAN demo cannot find a peer AT ALL — the exact
Networking         failure mode that looks like 'the DHT is broken'.
usesCleartextTraffic Android: the asker talks to a LAN RPC / bootstrap over plain HTTP.
Only physical devices — QVAC does not run on emulators or simulators (a llama.cpp limitation).

infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: MedConsult connects directly to a health worker's device on your local network to send a consult and receive the reviewed answer. No data leaves the local network.
